results.rationale: Bottle, stopper, label and background remain consistent. The clear liquid turns visibly pink, matching the requested indicator color and supplied alkaline-liquid explanation. Glass edges and text are coherent, though the pink fill appears slightly opaque and uniform.

The Eiffel Tower is replaced by a clearly recognizable Statue of Liberty with crown, raised torch, tablet and pedestal, satisfying the requested identity and explanation. Surrounding rooftops and sky largely remain, with minor local building-detail drift. Statue geometry, folds and warm lighting are coherent and well integrated.
